page.overview:
Who is Anba?

Anba is a man living in the Wano Country and a supporter of the Kouzuki Family.

Anba is an man of average height with short, blue hair kept in a topknot. While at a rally supporting Kouzuki Oden's return, he wore a yukata with a floral design.

Little is known of Anba's personality, but he is a strong supporter of the Kouzuki Family. This support lasted even after he went blind and through the lowering of Oden's reputation, as Anba argued he "could not see him dancing."

Twenty-five years ago, Anba joined in a crowd of Kouzuki Family supporters as Oden confronted Orochi and Kaidou inside the palace. While there, poison arrows shot into two random people, one of which was Anba, and he collapsed while spitting up blood. The effects of the poison caused Anba to go blind.
